svg.text: 116.4 MB of weights streamed per token

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The host writes POS, coin and the flags, pulses ap_start, then polls ap_done. Weights are resident in DDR from init and are re-streamed every token —

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: there is no weight reuse across tokens, so decode throughput is bounded by DDR bandwidth, not by MAC count.
